contracts.meaning: Explicit supported source/project/profile/resource selection for TDE — deterministic test-obligation derivation. Supported dialects and limits stay those of the selected current components.
Enable a Craft system builder to derive repeatable, source-traceable test obligations and inspect explicit unsupported or oracle-dependent residue from supported specification documents.
acceptance_conditions: The same supported documents and derivation rules produce byte-stable obligations and stable source-bound obligation keys.
Supported input dialects and parser rejections remain explicit; prose is not silently converted into behavioral semantics.
Generated assertion bodies are limited to supported decidable/binding-backed cases; oracle-dependent or unsupported cases remain visible residue.
Finite-case derivation and trusted-local native links retain their own source and executable identity boundaries.
exclusions: Unbounded semantic satisfiability or whole-system correctness
Automatic application generation from every obligation
A completed general DomainSpec v4 neutral-obligation or TDE-to-EVF join
Independent native build provenance, production qualification or owner admission
